subject: Mutual Action Plan — closure timetable & verification protocol
messages:
From: Alex Lee <alex.lee@novacare.com>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: priya.singh@novacare.com
Date: Sat, 14 Mar 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP & eval acceptance — proposed timeline

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. We have internal pressure to lock the pilot window and confirm what success looks like before our steering committee next Wed.

Can you send a short mutual action plan with: clear exit gates, the acceptance tests we'll run, owners for each test, and a target close date? Ideally we turn that into a one-page agreement and a test-runbook.

High-level constraints from our side:
- Minimal data residency concerns (US-only)
- Latency target: 95th percentile under 350ms for API-calls in typical demo traffic
- Evidence required: sample logs, a short smoke run with 5000 requests, and a pass/fail checklist per test case

If you can land a draft by Monday EOD we'll review before the committee. Also loop in ContractOps early for procurement.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Lee
VP, Digital Transformation
Novacare Health
From: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Lee <alex.lee@novacare.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai, soojin.lee@redwood.ai, priya.singh@novacare.com
Date: Mon, 16 Mar 2026 11:07:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual action plan + verification protocol (draft)

Alex / Priya —

Attached: novacare-map-v2.xlsx (MAP), acceptance-testcases-v1.md (test runbook), schedule-owners.pdf (owners/timeline).

Executive summary (short):
- Target: 6-week pilot starting 2026-04-01, goal to decide on commit by 2026-05-13.
- Exit gates: three incremental gates (Pilot smoke, Performance acceptance, Operational handoff). All gates have explicit pass/fail criteria and owners.
- Verification: scriptable test cases + human review; evidence artifacts stored in the shared workspace.

Key acceptance criteria (high level):
1) Functional correctness: 95% pass rate on labeled prompt set (500 samples) across clinical templates. Owner: Priya (Novacare); Redwood support: Soojin. Deadline: 2026-04-14.
2) Latency & reliability: 95th percentile latency <= 350ms under validation load; error rate < 0.5%. Owner: Ben (Redwood infra). Test: 5k synthetic requests replay. Deadline: 2026-04-21.
3) Cost/Throughput sanity: per-call cost within agreed threshold (see MAP sheet) across a 48hr stress run. Owner: Karthik. Deadline: 2026-04-28.
4) Security/compliance artifacts: SOC2 scope doc + audit log access validated for the pilot accounts. Owner: Marissa. Deadline: 2026-04-07 (early).

Exit gates (pass/fail + rollback):
- Gate 0 (Kickoff readiness): documentation, access, and test harness in place. Pass => begin pilot. Fail => remediate 3 business days.
- Gate 1 (Smoke): Functional correctness pass on baseline dataset. Fail => freeze feature surface and run triage with support.
- Gate 2 (Performance): Latency & reliability pass under scheduled load. Fail => fallback to smaller model variant + re-run within window.
- Gate 3 (Ops handoff): Observability and rollback playbook validated; procurement signed. Fail => extend pilot and schedule fix sprint.

Evidence items we will deliver per gate (examples):
- Test-run logs (CSV), aggregated latency histograms (PNG), pass/fail checklist (MD), short recorded demo (MP4).

Next steps & owners (short):
- Redwood: finalize the MAP spreadsheet + attach the acceptance test runbook (today). Owner: Karthik.
- Novacare: allocate test data owner and confirm network allowlist by 2026-03-19. Owner: Priya.
- ContractOps: start procurement worksheet and share redline deadlines. CC: contracts@novacare.com.

Questions for the committee (we'll surface these in the one‑pager):
- Is the 6-week pilot window acceptable?
- Are the latency and evidence artifacts sufficient for procurement signoff?

I'll convert the attached docs into a single one-pager for the committee review and share a link.

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Sr. Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
From: ben.carter@redwood.ai <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, soojin.lee@redwood.ai, Alex Lee <alex.lee@novacare.com>, priya.singh@novacare.com
Date: Tue, 17 Mar 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan + verification protocol (draft)

Karthik — quick notes from infra on the performance gate:

- For the 5k-request smoke we should define the exact request signature and warmup profile. I'll attach a sample JMeter script in the shared folder.
- Latency target: 95p <= 350ms is reasonable but let's add a secondary SLA: p50 <= 120ms so the committee has a tighter expectation.
- Failure modes: outline the automatic fallback to the quantized variant and a manual rollback procedure. That should be in the Gate 2 remediation column in the spreadsheet.

Also: Marissa, can you confirm which security artifacts are sufficient for procurement? SOC2 Type II report + evidence of encryption-in-transit/config should be okay, but we may need a short attestation letter for their compliance team.

I'll jump on the checklist and add the JMeter example.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Product Infrastructure Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Priya Singh <priya.singh@novacare.com>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, soojin.lee@redwood.ai, ContractOps <contracts@novacare.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2026 14:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan + verification protocol (draft)

Karthik/Ben — thanks, this looks good and granular enough for the committee. Two quick adjustments from procurement & security: 

1) Move the security artifact deadline earlier: we need SOC2 evidence by 2026-04-05 to start procurement review.
2) Procurement asks for a short acceptance checklist that they can attach to the PO (1 page). Could you produce that one-pager by 2026-03-19?

If you can update the MAP and drop the one-pager in the SharePoint link, we will circulate to the steering committee on Monday. ContractOps (copied) will start the redline clock — they expect initial comments within 72 hours after receipt.

We accept the 6-week window but prefer that gate dates remain fixed; if Gate 2 fails we will pause and reconvene for remediation rather than automatically extending.

Thanks — Priya
Priya Singh
Program Lead, Digital Innovation
Novacare Health
